item:ExpBalloon1.name: Small_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon1.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:ResetCompletedS.name: Star_Talent_Reset_Potion
item:ResetCompletedS.description: Hold down on this item to refund all your Star Talent Points! Well, except for the Star tab points, there's a different potion for... no wait, this IS the potion for that!

item:Crystal1.name: Desert_Topaz
item:Crystal1.description: Give this to the bird in town to unlock the portal to World 2! You can come back to World 1 whenever you want, don't worry.
